description:
After scenario-to-desktop's deploy stage successfully publishes to LPBS, there is no callback to deployment-manager recording what version was published for which platform. Add a callback from scenario-to-desktop's deploy stage completion to a new deployment-manager endpoint that records the published version per platform per profile. This closes the feedback loop so deployment-manager knows the current live state.

Source: research/desktop-release-control-plane-audit conclusion — Finding 9 gap #7.
name: desktop-post-publish-version-sync
title: Add post-publish version sync from scenario-to-desktop to deployment-manager
